findings.claim: Grab FY2025 20-F: 貿易應收款主要來自 Deliveries 與 Mobility 的商家、司機夥伴等，無重大客戶信用集中度。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 財報附註
findings.excerpt: There is no significant concentration of customer credit risk. In monitoring customer credit risk, customers are grouped according to their credit characteristics which includes geographic location and operating segment.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 業態為消費者平台，無大客戶集中；公司自身信評 2026 年 2 月 S&P 升 BB、4 月 Moody's 升 Ba2（僅搜尋摘要，未核原文）。

clues.claim: Moody's 將 Grab CFR 由 Ba3 升至 Ba2，展望穩定。
